paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Kapernaum a ahong lut nawnleh inn ah a-om chih thu ahong thang hi.
heading: Mizaw Hihdamna / (Mat 9.1-8; Luk 5.17-26)

paite: Huchi in kongkhak kim a omna ding om lou khop in mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, akiang uah thu agen hi.
Mizaw khat, mi li zawn, akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
Mipi ziak a akiangnai a ahong pai theih louh ziak un a-omna intung aphenvang ua; huai khit in alupna leh atung a mizaw lum kawm in akhaikhesuk uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh amuh in, mizaw kiang ah, "Ka tapa, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
Laigelhmi khenkhat huai mun ah atu uhi.
"Hiai mi'n bangziak a hichibang thu gen ahia? Pathian agensia hi; mi khat, Pathian kia lou ngal, kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in alungtang un angaihtuah uhi.
Huan Jesu'n, alungtang un huchibang angaihtuah uh chih alungsim in athei pah a, akiang uah, "Huai thu bangziak a na lungtang ua ngaihtuah na hi ua?
Mizaw kiang a, 'Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita,' chih leh 'na lupna la inla, khe in paita in,' chih akoi ahia agen nuamzaw?
Himahleh leitung ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," ahi, mizaw kiang ah;
"Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
Huchi in amah athou a, alupna la pah in, avek ua mitmuh in apaita hi; huchi in avek un lamdang asa mahmah uh, hichibang himhim i mu ngei kei, chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
Huan apawt nawn a tuipi gei ah apaita hi, mipi tengteng akiang ah ava pai ua, ama'n thu ana hilh hi.
heading: Levi Sapna / (Mat 9.9-13; Luk 5.27-32)

paite: Apai kawm in, Alphai tapa, Levi siah piakna mun a tu amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Athou a azuita hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n Levi inn ah an a-um a, siahkhonte leh mikhialte tampi in Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi, amah zuite tampi ahi uh.
Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n Jesu'n mikhialte leh siahkhonte kiang a anek amuh un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia siahkhonte leh mikhialte kiang a anek a adawn?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n huai aza a, akiang uah, "Michidamte'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamloute'n akiphamohzaw uh; midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.

Huan Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite'n an angawl zel uhi. Amau ahong pai ua, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangziak a Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite nungzuite'n an ngawl ua, nang nungzuite'n angolh sam louh uh?" achi uhi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Dotna / (Mat 9.14-17; Luk 5.33-39)

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupite kiang a apasal a-om lai teng moupite'n an angawl thei ua hia? Apasal ding akiang ua a-om lai teng angawl thei kei ding uh.
Himahleh akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uhi.
"Kuamah in puan tui khai nai louh them in puan lui athuap ngei kei uh; thuap le uh, thuap bit asawmna lam uah akaikek ding a, athak in alui akaikek ding a, ahong kek semsem ding hi.

Huan kuamah in savun uain thawl lui ah uain thak athun ngei kei, uain in savun thawl aphukham ding a, uain abo bei ding hi, savun thawl mah leng; uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu Sabbath ni in buhlei ah apaisuak hi, anungzuite'n apai kawm un buhvuite akhiak uhi.
heading: Sabbath Thu A Dotna / (Mat 12.1-8; Luk 6.1-5)

paite: Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "En dih, bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih ahi ua?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "David leh alawmte ataksap ua, agilkial lai ua athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
Abiathar siampu lianpen ahih lai a, Pathian inn a alut a, siampute kia lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam anek a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu,” achi hi.
Huan amah mah in, akiang uah, "Sabbath zaw mihing a dia bawl ahi, mihing bel Sabbath ni a dia bawl ahi kei hi.
Huchi in Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath tung nangawn a Toupa ahi," achi hi.
